title: One Coffee House in a Run-Down Nairobi Arcade: Java's 1999 Start
conflicts: Number of founders: Ashley says he founded Java 'together with three others' (Business Daily 2015), How we made it in Africa says three former relief workers, and three sources name only Ashley and Jon (John) Wagner; the story names both and says 'a few fellow American former relief workers' without a count. Branch counts (seven in 2007, ten by 2010, 13 in May 2012) are each given with their year and agree.
notes: Jon Wagner added to the founder field because three sources name him co-founder and The Guardian (2007) quotes him. The repeat screen flagged Folorunsho Alakija's Supreme Stitches edition only because both company names contain the word 'House' (Rose of Sharon House of Fashion); it let the edition through, so the company field was not reworded. Funding bootstrapped: expansion was paid from internal revenues until ECP's 2012 majority stake (Business Daily 2012). Quote stance: affirms.
